steps.content: You don't have to wait long before your next return. After reporting and confirming new survivors for almost twenty hours, you're finally sent back to rest.
And the moment you lie down, you're back in that somber dream.

Someone touches your forehead gently. You open your eyes slightly and see Hestia sitting by your side, her gaze wandering. She probably hasn't realized you're awake, her expression somewhat concerned and uneasy.
You cough softly. She immediately withdraws her hand and puts on an annoyed expression.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Why did it take you so long to wake up?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: You passed out for a long time. I tried and tried but couldn't wake you up. You freaked me out!

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Nonsense. How could I knock you out with your thick skin?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...Besides, you tricked me first. You changed your voice and pretended to be an adult. Think you could fool me just like that because I can't see?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Nasty little punk. I'll tell the captain about this when we get back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fine.

Your voice hasn't changed, nor has your appearance. But in her eyes, you've obviously become that <color=#fb9259>child guide</color> once again. No matter who you meet, you're always playing the same role of a person you don't know.
...It doesn't matter anymore. Knowing this is an <color=#fb9259>encounter</color> under the Illusory Moon, you won't be led by the nose again. You stand up and look around.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Do you know how to get back to the expedition?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: ...What get back? Just wait here.
Hearing your voice from above, she seems a bit irritated and stands up too.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Listen, little punk. I know we'd barely talked before, but now that we've decided to stick together, let's get a few things straight.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'm Hestia, the priestess of Stor Town, the oracle of the Pyromater, and the prophet of Nightfall. I have two hundred followers under me, and more importantly, a pair of eyes that can see through darkness.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Never fooled by illusions, they allow me to see the truth in darkness. God has guided me here to enlighten the lost lambs, and it's your expedition who's asked me to stay and provide assistance.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Got it? I'm your guide, so treat me with respect and trust. Heed the priestess's advice, for only I can lead you out of this forbidden land alive.
She stands up to you defiantly, while you recall how not long ago the priestess was scared into a teary mess just because her torch got snatched.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OK.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Hmm, keep that in mind.
Then, she begins listening carefully to the surroundings and even lowering her voice a bit.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Monsters lurk everywhere except this spot. We're safe here.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I've set up an alarm with bells. Stay near the magic circle and nothing will happen to you. Don't run around, and keep your voice down. Too much noise will attract them.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I still have plenty of food here. Enough to last until they come for you.
Hestia pats that little battered messenger bag she carries.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: So, who were you with? How did you get separated from them?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I came alone to find you.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No other adults are coming. We have to go find them ourselves.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Stop talking nonsense!
Conscious of her raised voice, Hestia pats her chest and speaks more softly.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Even adults may not be able to take down the monsters around here, what can two kids do? We'll be eaten alive the moment we step out!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aren't you a powerful priestess? Use your magic circle to get rid of the monsters.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The priestess is not adept at combat. I can only guide the way, leading you away from danger. This forbidden land is governed by the most atrocious deity. Those who do not heed the oracle will surely be...

steps.speaker: Option
options: Do the scholars believe what you say?

steps.content: Interrupted by you, Hestia pauses, flushing instantly.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: W-what...? Don't they also call you "Guide"? You're even younger than me, yet you always lead everyone around with your gibberish... If they can believe you, why can't they believe me too?

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: The Pyromater Sect of Stor Town is well-known in the deserts. I have followers everywhere. Do you think you can convince every one of them I'm a liar?
She says and knocks her torch against the ground, mustering a semblance of fragile authority.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I have already informed the captain of the situation. The priestess has accompanied you guys on your journey for too long. I must rest. That's why I stayed behind to wait for the expedition's return.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OK.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Such a safe hideout is hard to come by around here, so don't wander off. Stay here and wait for the adults to get us.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I'd rather it be anyone else but this little punk... What a nuisance.
She obviously doesn't like you too much, but it doesn't matter. You're more than happy to keep a distance.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Since it's safe here, you should stay.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I can protect myself. That red light you were so afraid of is my weapon. It's got me covered. I came all the way here with its help, I'll have no problem carrying on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since I'm a guide too, I should find my own way out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hey, you! Wait!
She stops you with her torch hastily, but you stride right over it.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: Wait a second!
Her panicked call stirs an eerie echo in the darkness. Shuddering, the girl stands up and bumps into your back, grabbing onto your clothes.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I... I'll go with you. You're too reckless. I must keep an eye on you so you don't die and make everyone sad.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Okay.

steps.speaker: Hestia
steps.content: I am not scared!!
You don't persist, letting her clutch the hem of your clothes while you lead the way, grateful that your mind still remains calm.
Stay calm. This is just a trap... You remind yourself.
